item.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
item.description: The latest attacks come two days after a clash between settlers and Palestinians near the village of Tell, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead.

item.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
item.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

item.title: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
item.description: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.
